contentPattern: Single-cell rows form the intro: text row (heading + paragraph), optional picture-only row (intro image), optional links-only row (CTA buttons). Each row with 2+ cells is one accordion item: cell 1 = question/summary, cell 2 = answer (rich text), optional cell 3 = item image (renders a card-like item with the image in the summary). Default layout: intro column left, item list right on desktop; 'stacked' puts a centered intro above the list and the CTA below it.
reuseGuidance: Use for any expandable Q&A list with an intro column. Use 'stacked' when the heading sits centered above boxed items with a CTA below. 'light', 'purple' and 'orange' are color-scheme hooks for the section background. For a plain accordion without intro, leave the intro rows empty.
usageDescription: FAQ / explainer sections: a heading with short intro text (and optionally an image or CTA) next to a list of expandable questions with plus indicators; items may carry an image for feature-card style lists.
